title: 桜花賞の後に・心躍る挑戦

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I greet Air Groove as she returns from her awe-inspiring performance in the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As expected from the Oka Sho, the competition was spectacularly fierce.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Races like this truly do set my heart alight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race has just finished, but Air Groove is ablaze with fighting spirit!
choice_data_list: You'll need to give even more at the Japanese Oaks.
You'll need to give even more at the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's get back. I want to go over today's race and start strategizing for the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Oaks is coming up fast. We can't afford to rest on our laurels!
